topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: Found granny's ring in a dingy pawn shop, huh? Don't say I didn't warn you. This city's got more secrets than a graveyard, and every shiny trinket tells a story.Requested to dig up the truth, I suppose? Fine with me, but this ain't going to be pretty. People get funny about family heirlooms, turn savage even. Seen it all, from the desperate trying to hock what little they have left to the guilty looking to erase the past. This ring's got a past, alright, and a present too. I'll trace its steps, but I ain't making any promises. In this town, what's lost isn't always just misplaced; it's often given up for a reason. I'll find out what that reason is. Just keep your expectations in check.
